risk_note: RV2 (linking/**, user authorization boundary and Taobao order attribution through relation_id; contracts/openapi.yaml only loses the x-implementation: planned lines of bindUnion and listUnionBindings, route-schemas.gen.ts regenerated). POST /v1/unions/{platform}/bindings checks then consumes the state (uid, device, device-record client, issued and still configured auth_method; failures 30104 / method_not_allowed leave the state unused), commits the consumption before exchanging the credential through UnionBindingExchanger (demo bindPublisher outside production; real filing TODO), then writes the binding and the idempotent response in one transaction; BR-ID-19 uniqueness and cooldown are decided by the partial unique indexes (23505 re-read under a savepoint: 30151 or success, conflict logged as a structured warn until B1-06y / B1-06z). Status changes go through linking/domain canTransitionBinding with a row_version CAS (approvals #26, until CT-10). Site authorization judged on the account actually used (shared with auth-url in union-auth-reads.ts); pdd POST answers 20001. GET /v1/unions/bindings lists taobao and pdd without account names, released_at or cooldown_until. Credentials never stored or logged. Written by hand.
